title: Auvers: The Final Months
intro: Portraits, village views and wide landscapes bring us into Vincent’s life and work in Auvers. His letters preserve plans for paintings, visits and the materials he needed. Beyond this room, the independent Afterlife gallery follows the work into other lives.
